content.comment_body: Hello! I'm new here and might sound inexperienced. I'm working with a [product_name] and trying to obtain an analog value through input AI7. The display shows a value, and when I use a multimeter, it reads between 0.1 and 4.15 volts. I think there might be a mistake in my programming and hope someone can assist me. Kind regards, [user_name]

Could you specify which type of [product_name] 12/24 Rco you have? Is it a [article_no]? Please mention the order number. What physical measurement range do you expect for AI7, and why are you using AI7? Is this signal connected via an analog expansion module, or does it come to terminal I7 of the base module?

Most versions of [product_name] 12/24 RCo support up to two analog inputs (0 to 10V). When working at terminal I7, you should program with AI1 (not AI7). Please make sure analog inputs are enabled on your [product_name]. In the current [product_name] configuration software, use: Files ; Properties ; Offline Settings ; I/O Settings ; Enable 2 analog inputs.
Thank you for your support. The solution was using A1—simple, yet tricky!

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced challenges while configuring analog inputs on a [product_name], mainly due to confusion between terminal names (I7) and programming channels (AI1). This led to trouble in activating and reading analog values. Specific, step-by-step guidance for enabling analog inputs in the relevant configuration software was very helpful for users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and easy mapping of analog inputs, with straightforward labeling and activation in the software for simpler setup.
